prompt:
Use aged paper, restrained sepia color, halftone print texture, and archival cutout framing.
Treat photographs and documents as tactile evidence layers with legible hierarchy.
Avoid: Glossy modern gradients, neon color, and playful preschool proportions.
Composition: Organize evidence in measured overlapping planes with one dominant archival focal point.
Composition: Preserve readable margins, captions, and document edges instead of filling every gap.
Cinematic fine-art archival PAPER COLLAGE, elegant album cover quality, exact landscape 1672x941 pixels. Each scrap has a clean complete silhouette. A faded printed blue seascape is visible inside the largest photograph, not words. FOREGROUND: Sparse isolated beige paper slivers and two small pressed olive leaves along the extreme lower-left and far right, with clean ragged paper edges.
